cards.title: Why it works
items: A single classifier node, complementary when-gates: the branch is gate grammar, not agent discretion
Empty queue is a RESULT — a notice echo ends the run quietly instead of a failed fan-out waking anyone
Routine work rides the batch fan-out; only urgent items spend a human escalation gate
